_comment: B-PREREG-FLIP (claude/ev-flip-hs): the two Qwen3.5-4B-family systems under H2O's shim readout, each on the 231 public items + their 1,593 jevkit perturbations (seed 0, order-preserving file sha256 be4abaa3...c42f, /data/jevbench-perturb/seed0-be4abaa3/pert_public_seed0_nosort.jsonl). Caps = measured job-zbtbj rates (H2O 75 s / 231, Qwen shim arm ~45 s / 231) x 7.9 items x ~1.7. Original list: claude/jev-host-scan.
billed_input_tokens: the longest single model input of the decision (Plan.max_call_input_tokens; the shim: its prompt), i.e. the prompt read once, as a prefix-cached server bills it

qwen35_4b.source: JevBench v1.6.1 board api_v161.json (sha256 5cd8c133...c83c1): deepinfra:Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (0.03 / 0.15 per 1M) frozen 25 Sep 2026, the price basis of every Qwen3.5-4B row incl. h2o-lightning-4b

ref_0p02.source: coordinator-declared reference input price 0.02 per 1M (Qwen3.5-2B / gemma-4-E4B, 2026-10-09 backbone research); output price not stated there: the board's small-model 0.15 per 1M is used (1 output token per decision, < 1 % of the cost)

d1_list.source: coordinator-declared d1 list price 0.04 per 1M input (2026-10-09); d1-3B was released 2026-10-05, so it cannot be a board list tariff yet (30-day rule) and is recorded as an estimate; output 0.15 per 1M as the small-model class (d1 reads zero output tokens; 1 counted)

le4b.source: size class <= ~4.7B params with no listing (LFM2.5-2.6B, Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, RWKV7 2.9B): the board's <= 4B reference, deepinfra:Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (JevBench v1.6.1 board api_v161.json (sha256 5cd8c133...c83c1)); ESTIMATE

le13b.source: size class 7-13B params with no listing (RWKV7-G1k-13.3B): the board's 12B reference, OpenRouter google/gemma-3-12b-it 0.05 / 0.15 (JevBench v1.6.1 board api_v161.json (sha256 5cd8c133...c83c1)); ESTIMATE

candidates.note: board leader (JevBench v1.6.1 Composite A 72.5); its own shim readout (vendored third_party/h2o_lightning_shim), lm head fp32 per its config.json head_dtype; identity check 205/231 (easy 48 / standard 71 / hard 86) per its v1.1 model card
H2O-Lightning's base; h2o_shim arm = the base under H2O's exact readout (isolates the fine-tune)

perturbed_items.note: B-PREREG-FLIP amendment 1: order-preserving serialization (run 1 file 655d028a was written with sort_keys, voiding reorder ops)
